description: This file declares functions related to ingress bandwidth control for the RTL8367C switch chip. It includes function prototypes for setting and getting ingress bandwidth parameters for specific ports, as well as enabling bypass modes.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIngressBandwidth
methods.description: Sets the ingress bandwidth parameters for a specified port, including bandwidth, pre-ifg, and flow control enablement.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIngressBandwidth
methods.description: Retrieves the ingress bandwidth parameters for a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIngressBandwidthBypass
methods.description: Enables or disables the ingress bandwidth control bypass mode.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIngressBandwidthBypass
methods.description: Checks whether the ingress bandwidth control bypass mode is enabled.
